required_fields.note: When N/A, the justification after -- is required (see validations).

validations.rule: if value contains 'N/A' (case-insensitive), the value MUST also contain a literal ' -- ' (space-dashdash-space) followed by a non-empty justification
validations.violation_message: Security review is N/A but has no justification. Use format: **Security review**: N/A -- <reason>
